summary: Iteration 258: Tested all 10 inbox redesign features - 5-tab bar, count badges, default active tab, tab filtering, AI mode toggle, toggle cycling, Team Inbox toggle, and conversation tap routing. All features verified WORKING.

issues: Many conversations display 'Human' label in blue (#007AFF) instead of gray (textSecondary #8E8E93). This occurs because these conversations have ai_mode stored as a non-standard value (possibly boolean true or legacy value) that is neither 'off' nor matches 'auto_reply'/'draft_only'/'auto_with_approval'. The pill shows 'Human' label but with blue color - minor cosmetic issue with legacy data.

critical_code_review_comments: data-testid on TouchableOpacity NOT forwarded to DOM in React Native Web. The test IDs inbox-tab-assigned, inbox-tab-waiting, inbox-tab-ai_active, inbox-tab-unassigned, inbox-tab-all and ai-mode-toggle-{conversationId} are NOT accessible via data-testid selector in browser automation. The tab elements render as div[tabindex=0] without the attribute. Recommend: For web, use IS_WEB check and render native button elements with data-testid (similar to WebIconButton pattern already in the file), or use testID prop with a custom web View wrapper.

Some conversations show 'Human' in blue due to legacy ai_mode values (possibly boolean true or unknown strings). Consider adding validation/migration: if ai_mode is not one of ['off', 'draft_only', 'auto_reply', 'auto_with_approval'], treat as 'off' in the display logic.
action_items: Fix data-testid forwarding on TouchableOpacity for tab bar items and AI mode toggle pills. Either use IS_WEB branch with native button elements, or use Pressable + testID prop that React Native Web can forward.
Optional: Normalize legacy ai_mode values in display logic - treat unknown values as 'off' to show gray Human instead of blue Human.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 258 verified all inbox redesign features. The 5-tab bar (Assigned/Waiting/AI Active/Unassigned/All) works correctly with count badges and colored underlines. AI mode toggle pills are visible per row and cycle Human->Assist->Auto->Human. Team Inbox hides the 5-tab bar. Conversation tap routes to /thread/{id}. NOTE: data-testid attributes on TouchableOpacity elements are NOT forwarded to DOM in React Native Web - use div[tabindex=0] with style matching or text-based selectors for automation.
